summary: E11 Driver Payroll / HR Lite module testing completed. Backend APIs 100% functional (68/68 tests passed). Frontend UI mostly working with 1 critical RBAC issue: Payroll tab visible to driver role (backend correctly blocks with 403, but UI should hide tab). All core features tested: compensation config, payout generation, approve/pay workflow, bonus/deduction editing, Finance integration, slip export.

backend_issues.notes: All backend APIs working perfectly. RBAC correctly enforced at API level.

rbac_issues.issue: Payroll tab visible to driver role in Finance page
rbac_issues.description: Driver role can see and click the Payroll tab in Finance page. Backend correctly returns 403 for API calls, but the frontend UI should hide the Payroll tab entirely for driver role. The TABS array in Finance.jsx does not filter based on user role/sections.
rbac_issues.expected_behavior: Payroll tab should only be visible to owner and ops_admin roles (users with 'finance' section access)
rbac_issues.current_behavior: Payroll tab is visible to all logged-in users including driver role

Backend: Authentication for owner, ops_admin, driver
Backend: Compensation RBAC - driver gets 403 on GET/PATCH /api/drivers/{id}/compensation
Backend: Compensation CRUD - owner/ops_admin can update all compensation fields
Backend: Payroll summary endpoint returns correct KPI data
Backend: List payouts with status and driver_id filters
Backend: Generate payout creates draft with correct calculations
Backend: Duplicate payout generation blocked with 400
Backend: Invalid period validation (end < start) returns 400
Backend: Update payout draft - bonus/deduction editing and total recalculation
Backend: Approve payout - status changes, Finance expense created (akrual)
Backend: Pay payout - status changes, expense marked as paid (realisasi kas)
Backend: Delete payout - only draft can be deleted, paid blocked with 400
Backend: Slip export - PDF and Excel with correct content-types
Backend: Driver role blocked from all payroll endpoints (403)
Frontend: Owner login and navigation to Finance → Payroll tab
Frontend: Payroll Manager component loads with KPI cards
Frontend: Generate Payout button and dialog functional
Frontend: Driver Detail Drawer → Kompensasi tab visible to owner
Frontend: Compensation Dialog with all 4 components (base salary, commission per trip, commission % revenue, allowance per km)
Frontend: Compensation toggles (enable/disable per component)
Frontend: Driver RBAC - Kompensasi tab correctly hidden in Driver Detail Drawer for driver role
Frontend: Payout table displays payouts with status pills
Frontend: Status filter in Payroll tab

critical.issue: Payroll tab visible to driver role in Finance page
critical.fix: Add role-based filtering to TABS array. The Payroll tab should only be visible to users with 'finance' section access (owner/ops_admin). Check user.sections or user.role and conditionally include the payroll tab in the TABS array. Example: const TABS = [..., ...(canAccessFinance ? [['payroll', 'Payroll', Users]] : [])]
critical.verification: After fix, login as driver@demo.local and verify that the Payroll tab is NOT visible in Finance page

compensation_config.notes: All 4 compensation components (base salary, commission per trip, commission % revenue, allowance per km) can be configured with toggles. Revenue base (trip/booking) selection works. Backend validation for invalid revenue_base returns 400.

compensation_rbac.notes: Driver role correctly blocked from GET/PATCH /api/drivers/{id}/compensation (403). Kompensasi tab correctly hidden in Driver Detail Drawer for driver role. Owner and ops_admin have full access.

payroll_summary.notes: GET /api/payroll/summary returns correct KPI data (count, by_status, accrued_total, paid_total). Driver role blocked with 403.

list_payouts.notes: GET /api/payroll/payouts returns array. Filtering by status and driver_id works. Driver role blocked with 403.

generate_payout.notes: POST /api/payroll/payouts/generate creates draft payout with correct ID prefix (dpo_), status, driver_id, period_type, and calculated totals. Duplicate generation blocked with 400. Invalid period validation works. Driver role blocked with 403.

payout_detail.notes: GET /api/payroll/payouts/{id} returns complete payout with bonuses, deductions, and all fields. Non-existent payout returns 404.

update_payout_draft.notes: PATCH /api/payroll/payouts/{id} updates bonuses, deductions, notes. Totals recalculated correctly (gross + bonus - deduction). Only draft payouts can be updated.

approve_payout.notes: POST /api/payroll/payouts/{id}/approve changes status to approved, sets approver_id, approver_name, approved_at. Finance integration creates expense with category gaji_driver, paid=false (akrual). Expense_id stored in payout.

pay_payout.notes: POST /api/payroll/payouts/{id}/pay changes status to paid, sets paid_at. Linked expense marked as paid=true (realisasi kas).

delete_payout.notes: DELETE /api/payroll/payouts/{id} only works for draft payouts. Approved/paid payouts blocked with 400. Returns {deleted: true, id}.

slip_export.notes: GET /api/payroll/payouts/{id}/slip?format=pdf returns PDF with correct content-type (application/pdf). format=excel returns xlsx with correct content-type (spreadsheetml). Driver role blocked with 403.

finance_integration.notes: Approve creates expense (category=gaji_driver, paid=false). Pay marks expense as paid=true. Single expense per payout (no double-counting). Expense amount matches payout total.

ui_payroll_tab.notes: Payroll tab in Finance page loads correctly with KPI cards (Total Akrual, Total Dibayar, Draft, Disetujui/Dibayar). Payout table displays correctly. Generate Payout button functional. ISSUE: Tab visible to driver role (should be hidden).

ui_compensation_dialog.notes: Compensation dialog accessible from Driver Detail Drawer → Kompensasi tab. All 4 components with toggles present. Revenue base dropdown works. Correctly hidden for driver role in drawer.

ui_payout_detail.notes: Could not fully test payout detail dialog due to navigation issues in test script. Backend APIs fully tested and working.
